newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel budget director to step down March 1.
newsitem.headline: Israel budget director to step down March 1.

text.p: The director of the Israeli Treasury's budget department, Ron Croll, announced on Sunday he would leave his post on March 1 to work in the private sector.

The Treasury said Croll will be replaced by David Milgram, currently deputy managing director of Pelephone, the cellular phone operation jointly owned by Bezeq Israel Telecom and Motorola Inc. Milgram formerly was deputy director of the budget department.

There was no indication that Croll's resignation was related to the government's current battle to win parliamentary approval for 1997 budget cuts of up to seven billion shekels. The budget must be approved by December 31.
